content.short: Hyperbeat is a self-custodial onchain account on Hyperliquid to save, spend, trade and ramp.
content.description: Hyperbeat packages saving, spending, trading and fiat ramps into one self-custodial smart wallet on HyperEVM. Users sign up with an email, set up passkeys and fund the account from a wallet or a bank transfer, with no exchange or bank in the middle. A credit card spends against the portfolio by borrowing rather than selling, and trading covers assets at up to forty times leverage. High-yield accounts and fiat conversion sit in the same interface.
content.meta: Saving, spending, trading and fiat onramping through one self-custodial Hyperliquid account.
